title: Insert 10-second pauses every few minutes when learning.
subtitle: Micro-offline gains
rationale: Brief eyes-open rest gaps let the brain replay just-practiced material, compressing extra repetitions into the session.

evidence.summary: Lab studies show rapid offline consolidation during 10-second rests in motor learning; extension to knowledge work is extrapolation.

sources.label: Rapid offline consolidation in skill learning

indications: A new skill or codebase must be absorbed fast.
Study sessions run dense with no pauses.
